ledger.x: c. 900 BCE: the Chavín culture develops in the northern highlands. Infobox 'Dates: 900-250 BCE'; the intro says it developed 'around 900 BCE'. The Chavín de Huántar page dates building from 'prior to 1200 BC' and most major construction by 750 BC (conflict).

c. 250 BCE: the Chavín culture ends. Infobox and intro give about 250 BCE; the site's religious function 'had ceased prior to 400 BC' and the New Temple was built 500-200 BC. Heirs per the infobox: Moche, Lima, Nazca.

certainty.note: A culture of shared religion and iconography; no borders.
